name: Maou Hajimemashita
source:
Masato Akutsu was an ordinary (?) horny high school boy. 

He and his bad-influence friend Taichi Yamada liked to peep on the girls in the locker room. 

Masato recently kept having the same dream. That dream had some meaning, he was sure. 

Then, his body began The Change. 

A sci-fi ero comedy novel game.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE113313.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
阿久津正人是一个普通的（？）好色的高中生。

他和他的坏朋友山田太一喜欢偷看更衣室里的女孩们。

正人最近一直做着同样的梦。他确信那个梦有一定的意义。

然后，他的身体开始了变化。

一款科幻色情喜剧小说游戏。
